scope: Test companion only; not the production planner, journal, coordination or apply implementation.

cases.expectation: A fresh run-owned workspace is absent, created once, read back with exact org/name/synthetic admin, and has no contexts/defaults/experiments; non-404 bootstrap failures dispatch zero writes.

Two complete inventory passes agree on full rows/order and version fences; page totals/counts, duplicates, missing rows, malformed bodies and byte/page caps refuse. Known fixture IDs are required to prove full scope.
Prefix listing is explicitly lossy; full unfiltered rows retain unrelated keys and descriptions and supply replacement inputs.
Create on existing condition merges; PATCH replacement removes omitted managed key while preserving supplied unrelated fields/description/condition; delete-missing rejects.

Dimension enum extension retains other schema properties; defaults retain value/schema/functions/description on conflicts; malformed override rejects and prior separately committed prerequisites remain.
One invalid action rolls back every context action and config version; prior prerequisite commits remain. One dispatched bulk only; no hidden batches.
Latest/repeated/version-specific exports agree, expose actual context order, and provide version/Last-Modified metadata independently of SDK defaulting.
Otherwise identical overrides with [A,B] and [B,A] are compared by direct rows, server override IDs and exported map; collisions are explicitly unsupported, never sorted away.
Active experiment-referenced contexts resist destructive writes; overlap response is observed without assumed universal policy; unrelated experiments remain identical.
Exact authenticated fixture identities prove complete reads, denied writes and cross-workspace/org refusal; demo-mode success does not certify deployed permissions.
Measure configured gateway/server action and byte boundary, including at/over limit, with exact image/config evidence. Local 16-action/1-MiB bounds are refusals, not measured server maxima.
